cwe_content.cwe: CWE-22,Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory ('Path Traversal')

candidate.Reason: The filename is directly taken from user-controlled PATH_INFO without proper sanitization, allowing path traversal attacks.
Joining user-controlled filename with directory path without proper validation can lead to directory traversal.
Checking file existence before proper path validation may allow attackers to probe the filesystem.
